note: Sirocco Y Sol substitute decisions, 2026-08-15. The kitchen chose to use existing stock for all six rather than buy the exact ingredient. When wiring DishIngredient / PrepIngredient rows, any recipe line naming `recipeIngredient` must point at `inventoryItemId` instead of creating a new item.

mappings.usedBy: grilled Mediterranean vegetables, chicken souvlaki, Spanish paprika chicken, lamb kefta, lemon-oregano dressing

mappings.caveat: Plain black olives for a mix. ~165 g per one-of-each round, so 500 g is about three rounds.

mappings.usedBy: quick pickled red onion, Spanish bravas sauce
mappings.caveat: Balsamic is sweeter and darker; the pickle will read differently.
Still unverified whether this 20 kg is dried or canned. The falafel method requires dried and soaked. If canned, the falafel will not bind.

mappings.usedBy: Spanish bravas sauce, Spanish paprika chicken, Patatas Bravas raw dusting
mappings.caveat: COLLISION: `Spanish paprika chicken` lists sweet paprika 1.8 g AND smoked paprika 0.7 g as separate lines. Both now resolve to this one item, but PrepIngredient is unique on (prepItemId, ingredientItemId) — so they must be merged into a single 2.5 g line, not two rows.
At 1.5-1.9 g per portion the difference is negligible.
